claims: Assess and manage severe pain (rated up to 10/10) with the current IV opioid regimen, monitoring respiratory status given NIV support.
Continue noninvasive ventilation (NIV-ST) with PEEP 5 cmH2O and PSV 5 cmH2O, titrating to maintain adequate oxygenation and ventilation.
Monitor arterial blood gases to assess hypercapnia (pCO2 51 mmHg) and acid-base status.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (vancomycin, levofloxacin, metronidazole) for presumed infection, with reassessment of cultures and clinical response.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory rate closely, with alarms set for desaturation (SpO2 <88%) and tachypnea.
Assess and manage agitation and delirium (RASS 0 to -1, CAM-ICU negative) with nonpharmacologic measures and cautious use of lorazepam as needed.
Continue chest physiotherapy and airway clearance with nebulized acetylcysteine and bronchodilators as ordered.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium, phosphate) and replace as needed, given recent supplementation.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with heparin as prescribed.
Perform a thorough skin and mobility assessment (Braden score) and implement pressure injury prevention and early mobilization strategies.
